title: Double Drip 10K Banana Ice Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: Designed for use with the Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kit, this Pod & Refill Pack provides a simple, low-maintenance way to keep your Double Drip 10K topped up with flavour. Each pack includes a prefilled 2ml pod and a 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit (depending on personal usage) with smooth, consistent vapour throughout. Banana Ice is a smooth and mellow blend that pairs sweet, ripe Banana with a crisp wave of Menthol. The result is a cool, creamy vape that’s satisfying from the first puff to the last. Once your original pod and refill are finished, replacing them is quick and fuss-free—just slot in the new pod and let the auto-refill system do the rest. Whether you're looking to extend your device’s lifespan or stock up on your favourite flavour, this Pod & Refill Pack keeps the experience clean, cost-effective, and hassle-free.
